task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into SuiteCRM and navigates to the Quotes creation module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SuiteCRM dashboard or the 'Create Quote' form is visible in the browser.

task_completion.description: The Quote Title, Quote Stage, and Account Name are correctly entered.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The fields show Title: 'Q3 Infrastructure Quote - Tech Data', Quote Stage: 'Draft', and Account: 'Tech Data Corporation'.

task_completion.description: The first group 'Software Subscriptions' is created with the correct product, quantity, and price.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A group header named 'Software Subscriptions' is visible containing 'Red Hat Enterprise Linux (1 Year)' with Quantity '20' and List Price '799.00'.

task_completion.description: The second group 'Professional Services' is created with the correct product, quantity, and price.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A second group header named 'Professional Services' is visible containing 'Server Architecture Consulting (Hours)' with Quantity '40' and List Price '185.00'.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the quote and the system confirms the record creation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' button is clicked, and the screen transitions to the 'Detail View' of the saved quote showing the assigned ID and the 'Q3 Infrastructure Quote - Tech Data' title.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than manipulating the database via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with form fields and buttons in the browser.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the CRM menus rather than jumping directly to a final success URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the process of clicking 'Create' or 'Quotes' from the navigation bar.

integrity.description: The agent typed or selected the specific account 'Tech Data Corporation' from the CRM's lookup/search tool.
integrity.visual_evidence: The account selection pop-up or search results for 'Tech Data' are visible during the process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The quote must have exactly two groups. Group 1: 'Software Subscriptions' with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (1 Year), Qty 20, Price 799.00. Group 2: 'Professional Services' with Server Architecture Consulting (Hours), Qty 40, Price 185.00. The Title must be 'Q3 Infrastructure Quote - Tech Data', Stage must be 'Draft', and Account must be 'Tech Data Corporation'.
